name: Org-Nouveau
summary: Org-Nouveau is a visual art-inspired style prevalent in the late 1980s to 1990s.
description:
Org-Nouveau is a visual art-inspired style prevalent in the late 1980s to 1990s. It is centered on fluent natural lines, organic architecture, and a revival of early-20th-century Art Nouveau and Catalan Modernisme. It features growing, wet, or skeletal natural forms, whiplash, sinuous lines and asymmetrical "S" curves, replicating vines, tendrils, and stems.

The main focus of this visual aesthetic includes stones, fluid stairwells, ironwork and grotto-based elements, coral-like structures, watery, under-the-sea iridescence, melting, cavernous plaster forms, carved wood, wrought iron, stone, and stained glass shaped to look fluid or alive.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Naturalism
